title: X Series Machine Base Installation Guide
body_html:
X Series Machine Base Installation Guide

Machine Base of X Series is a practical installation guide designed to help users correctly set up the optional base for the X Series laser machine. This guide explains proper placement, secure mounting, and configuration for pass-through door operation to ensure stable performance and safe use.

Overview of the X Series Machine Base

The X Series offers an optional machine base designed to:

  • Increase working height for better ergonomics
  • Provide additional internal space
  • Support pass-through door operation
  • Improve overall machine stability

The base ensures proper alignment and structural support for the laser machine during operation.

Installation Steps

Step 1: Position the Base

Place the machine base on a flat and stable desk or floor surface. Ensure the surface is level and capable of supporting the full machine weight.

Step 2: Mount the Machine

Carefully lift and position the X Series laser machine onto the base. Align it properly and secure it tightly to prevent movement during engraving or cutting operations.

Make sure the machine sits evenly on the base without tilting.

User Guide for Pass-Through Door Use

If you plan to use the pass-through door feature:

  • Confirm the internal partition placement inside the base
  • Adjust the internal layer position according to your material size
  • Ensure the structural setup is complete before operation

Proper internal configuration ensures smooth material feeding and prevents misalignment during processing.

Stability and Safety Tips

  • Always install the base on a solid, level surface
  • Double-check that all mounting points are secure
  • Confirm the structure is fully assembled before powering on the machine
  • Recheck alignment after installation

Proper installation of the machine base helps reduce vibration, improves cutting accuracy, and enhances long-term durability.

Conclusion

The optional X Series machine base enhances stability, ergonomics, and pass-through functionality. By following the correct installation steps and confirming internal partition placement, you ensure safe operation and optimal laser performance.
